name: Isle Be Wild, Brodick Castle
description: Isle Be Wild woodland playground on Arran, with raised wooden walkways and netting, a tower, rope bridges and a glass-bottomed tunnel.
fee: Non-members pay to visit the country park and garden: £10 adult, £5 child. National Trust for Scotland members get in free.
